purpose: Select the commercial/procurement mechanism appropriate to a Product Twin or project requirement instead of forcing every product through retail checkout.

route.route_type: merchant_cart | direct_trade | configured_rfq | supplier_quote | tender | distributor_order | local_purchase | unresolved
route.state: ready | needs_account | needs_requirement | needs_identity | needs_quote | needs_address | needs_logistics | needs_technical_review | blocked

selection_priority: correct commercial mechanism for the product type
principle: The existence of a retail checkout does not mean retail checkout is the correct procurement route for an engineered building product.
